_about: Attribution and display rules for the data sources page (engine/sources.py, web /sources). Verified 2026-11-17.
label: Public records copied into the 25x125 database. Estimates built from them are not tax, legal, zoning or appraisal advice.

display.zori: used for rent growth rates only; no Zillow figure is shown
display.csik-bsws: used to check the rent factor; not shown per parcel

attribution.name: City of Chicago Data Portal
attribution.text: This site provides applications using data that has been modified for use from its original source, www.cityofchicago.org, the official website of the City of Chicago. The City of Chicago makes no claims as to the content, accuracy, timeliness, or completeness of any of the data provided at this site. The data provided at this site is subject to change at any time. It is understood that the data provided at this site is being used at one's own risk.

attribution.name: Cook County Open Data and Cook County Assessor
attribution.text: Parcel, sale, value and building records come from the Cook County data catalog and the Cook County Assessor's Office. The County does not guarantee their accuracy or completeness.

attribution.name: Cook County Treasurer
attribution.text: Annual Tax Sale lists are the Treasurer's free ward reports. Amounts change as owners pay; confirm any balance with the Treasurer. Owner names and mailing addresses are not stored.

attribution.name: U.S. Census Bureau
attribution.text: This product uses Census Bureau data but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.

attribution.name: Federal Housing Finance Agency
attribution.text: House price indexes are from the FHFA House Price Index, a public data set.

attribution.name: Background map
attribution.text: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License. Tiles cut with Protomaps.

attribution.name: Chicago City Clerk
attribution.text: Zoning map amendment records are from the Office of the City Clerk's legislative system. District changes were read from the ordinance scans by software and checked against the record; rows that failed a check show no districts.

not_used: MLS (MRED) listings and sold data: not in this version.
Paid cost books and paid data feeds: not in this version.
Zillow rent figures: growth rates are used inside the rent estimate; no Zillow number is shown.
